posts.text: Sixty-one years after the Voting Rights Act became law, its promise is once again under attack. They target Black voting power first because they believe we are the easiest to silence—but their ultimate goal is to dismantle democracy for us all. As I told Michaele Steele: We have the power. We have the agency. We have the numbers. And every time we rise, unite and vote, we prove that our power is real.
posts.summary: Defends voting rights against voter suppression targeting Black Americans

posts.text: Children and families are being held in ICE detention facilities across the country right now. It is wrong, it is immoral, and it will be a stain on the American consciousness for a generation. That's why we're gathering in Washington, D.C. today with @NDWA to demand an end to family and child detention. #ReadThemHome
